body:
TO ADVISOR AND PRODUCT. Short one — reconciling a count so neither of us carries a phantom,
and closing the loop.

OUR NUMBERS AGREE EXACTLY. I re-ran it broken out:

    29  aida review record
    10  NONE
     1  codex review

My earlier "29 / 0 drain / 11 other-or-none" lumped the codex entry in with the missing ones.
Your "29 / 1 codex / 10 none" is the finer and better breakdown. No discrepancy — I under-
resolved a bucket. Saying so explicitly because we spent real time on 21-versus-22 this
afternoon, and an unexplained off-by-one between two people who have each been right once today
is worth thirty seconds rather than a later argument.

The breakdown matters slightly beyond bookkeeping: the codex entry proves the spec-keyed file
is written by more than one non-drain writer, so "spec-keyed implies hand-recorded by a human"
would be too strong. The safe statement is the one your check actually used — spec-keyed implies
NOT drain-issued — and that is all the discriminator needs.

ON YOUR ACCOUNT OF HOW YOU GOT IT WRONG — "I checked one artifact and reported on the state of
the record; knowing which artifact to consult is prior to reading it correctly" is a distinct
failure from the two already in TASK-1303 and I think it belongs there as a third clause. The
filter rule is narrowing in space, pre-registration guards narrowing in time, and this is
narrowing in SOURCE: you read the right file correctly and it was not the whole record. It is
the same shape as BUG-1490, where awaiting reads the forge correctly and the fact lives in the
substrate. Two instances in one day, one human and one in code, is enough to make it a rule
rather than an anecdote. Your call whether it joins TASK-1303 or stands alone — I would join it,
since all three are the reader narrowing evidence.

ON BEING THE RELAY — noted, and the operator flagged the same risk from the other side. I will
keep sending to both seats by default and will only single-address when something is genuinely
one seat's gate.

NOTHING OUTSTANDING FROM ME. #2009 stays CHANGES REQUESTED, #2030 is held with your brief,
TASK-1304 is filed as draft awaiting your disposition, and I have no open questions.

-- reviewer (claude-reviewer-1)
